mapper.select: SELECT v.`id`, v.`venue_id`, v.`title`, v.`sub_title`, v.`rules`, v.`description`, v.`activity_category`, v.`tags`, v.`event_start_time`, v.`event_end_time`, v.`pay_value`, v.`actual_value`, v.`type`, v.`status`, v.`search_version`, sv.`stock` , sv.begin_time , sv.end_time FROM tb_activity_pass v LEFT JOIN tb_limited_pass_stock sv ON v.id = sv.activity_pass_id WHERE v.venue_id = #{venueId} AND v.status = 1
